DATED 01.02.2023, AGAINST THE PETITIONER UNDER SECTIONS 498A, 504, 323, 114 R/W 34 OF IPC AND DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT UNDER SECTION 3, 4 PENDING BEFORE THE 2ND ADDL. CIVIL JUDGE (SR.DN.) THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

In this petition, petitioners seek the following reliefs:
(a) To quash the FIR and complaint in Crime No.14/2023 filed by the Respondent Police Davanagere Women P.S dated 01.02.2023, against the petitioner under Sections 498-A, 504, 323, 114 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Dowry Prohibition Act under Section 3, 4, pending before the 2nd Addl. Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.)
& JMFC Court, Davanagere, as vide Annexure-A and B and (b) to grant such other relief or reliefs as this Hon'ble Court be pleased to grant, along with imposing cost on the respondents, and including the cost of the petition by allowing the above petition, in the interest of justice.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Addl. SPP for respondent No.1 and perused the material on record.

3. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that respondent No.2 - complainant is the wife of petitioner No.1- accused No.1, while accused No.2 - petitioner No.2 is the sister of petitioner No.1 - accused No.1.

In the matrimonial proceedings in Crl.Mis.186/2023 filed during the pendency of the present petition, petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 have amicably settled their Matrimonial Case between them before the Lok-Adalath and have patched up their differences.

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, in view of the settlement arrived at between the petitioner No.1-husband and respondent No-2 wife, no useful purpose would be served in continuing the present proceedings as against the petitioners and accordingly, the same deserves to be quashed.

5. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed.

(ii) The impugned criminal proceedings in Crime No.14/2023 registered by respondent No.1 - NC: 2025:KHC:6166 Police, pending on the file of the II Additional Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.) and JMFC,
Davanagere, in so far as the petitioners are concerned, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
